Ad creatives · Video scripts · Meta

Video ad scripts

Three talking-to-camera scripts, each around 30 to 45 seconds, in your own voice.

Script 1 · “Not how to date”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“We’re born knowing how to love, but not how to date.”

Body

“Nobody teaches us how to date. So smart, thoughtful people end up repeating the same patterns and wondering why it isn’t working. The good news: dating is a skill, and skills can be learned.”

CTA

“I’m teaching a free live class called Date Smarter. Tap Sign up to save your seat. The replay is included.”

Shot: close-up talking to camera, same setup as your talking reels.

Script 2 · “Blind spots”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“The hardest thing to see in dating is your own pattern.”

Body

“As a behavioral scientist, I’ve seen the same few blind spots come up again and again. They shape who we choose and how we decide, and most people never notice them. Once you can see yours, you can change it.”

CTA

“In my free class I’ll walk you through the 3 blind spots and how to work with yours. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “1, 2, 3” in your serif type.

Script 3 · “After the date”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“The most important part of a date happens after it’s over.”

Body

“Most people walk away asking ‘did they like me?’ Better questions are: what side of me did they bring out? How did I feel during the date? That’s how you start choosing on purpose.”

CTA

“Join my free live class, Date Smarter. Sixty minutes, replay included. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to the questions on screen in your red and cream style.
